notes.title: 🍕 Dev Log #5 – From Early Access to Now (and What’s Next)
notes.content:
[p]Since launching into Early Access, we’ve been busy. Really busy.
In just a few weeks, we’ve pushed out numerous hotfixes, quality-of-life updates, and balance tweaks—all driven by your feedback. We want to say [i]thank you[/i] to everyone who has been sharing thoughts, bug reports, and ideas. Your voices are shaping Pizza Bandit every step of the way.[/p][p]Our next major update will be rolling out [b]within September[/b], and here’s what you can expect:[/p][hr][/hr][h2]📝 TL;DR – What’s Coming in the Next Update[/h2][list][*][p]🤖 [b]New Companion NPC[/b] – Meet [b]N.I.C.O.[/b], your Neural Interface Companion Operator[/p][/*][*][p]🎖️ [b]Papa Prestigio Rank 6[/b] – New buff + ~50 autumn-themed furniture items[/p][/*][*][p]💉 [b]New Gear[/b] – The [b]Vital Injector[/b] healing pistol (already live—check your Blueprint unlocks!)[/p][/*][*][p]🔧 [b]More fixes & polish[/b] – Continuing to squash bugs and refine based on your feedback[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]1. Companion NPC – Meet N.I.C.O.[/h2][p]Some of you might remember that we initially teased a shotgun-wielding human companion to support players in Solo mode. But during development, something didn’t feel right.
The character looked so capable that when we gave them proper combat stats, they became [i]too[/i] strong—strong enough to make the player feel unnecessary. That goes against the whole idea: companions should support new and solo players, not play the game for them.[/p][p]So, we pivoted. Instead of a powerhouse fighter, your trustworthy partner will be [b]N.I.C.O. (Neural Interface Companion Operator)[/b].[/p][list][*][p]NICO is part of your spaceship, introduced as the “final missing part” you recover during the tutorial. (Previously this was just a boring control panel—now it’s a living, quirky companion!)[/p][/*][*][p]Once you bring NICO back to the ship, the tutorial wraps up, and from then on, NICO accompanies you during solo play.[/p][/*][*][p]Right now, NICO helps fight by your side, but we plan to expand its role into utility and convenience features worthy of its name.[/p][/*][/list][p]Sadly, if you’ve already finished the tutorial, you won’t see this new introduction unless you start fresh—but you’ll still meet NICO in Solo missions. [/p][p]We are still working on NICO. Here's a little silhouette of NICO.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44324763/0504c8b3b139cd9d4698105bf9d57d1a228cace7.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2]2. Papa Prestigio Rank 6[/h2][p]Until now, Papa Prestigio has capped at Rank 5 (8,000 points). Many of you went far beyond that without meaningful rewards. It's time to fix that.[/p][p]We’re adding [b]Rank 6[/b], complete with:[/p][list][*][p]A brand-new Papa Buff (details soon).[/p][/*][*][p]~50 new furniture items (final count may change slightly).[/p][/*][/list][p]This set is autumn-themed and includes some of your most-requested items: sofas, stand-alone chairs, stand-alone tables, instruments, lighting, menu boards, and more ways to bring atmosphere to your restaurant.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44324763/f4b97de4401765870f1c377b1b42853f7a5ca26d.png"][/img][/p][p]
We’re also rebalancing some existing Papa Buff effects to match community feedback better.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]3. New Gear – Vital Injector[/h2][p]If you’ve been playing recently, you should already have access to the [b]Vital Injector[/b], our newest secondary weapon.[/p][list][*][p]It’s a pistol that heals allies when you shoot them.[/p][/*][*][p]Designed to be available early in the game to help out new players.[/p][/*][*][p]For those who had already passed that point in progression, the Blueprint should have unlocked automatically with the update.[/p][/*][/list][p]More Gear is in development based on your suggestions, and we’ll share details once they’re ready.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]Wrapping Up[/h2][p]Early Access isn’t just about fixing bugs (though we’ve squashed plenty already)—it’s about growing Pizza Bandit with you. These updates are our way of answering your feedback directly, and we’re excited for you to try them out when they land [b]later this month[/b].[/p][p]As always: keep the comments, bug reports, and ideas coming.
Together, we’ll keep making Pizza Bandit bigger, better, and weirder.[/p][p]— Team JofSoft[/p]

notes.title: 🍕 A Quick Word on AI in Pizza Bandit
notes.content:
[p][b]Hey everyone,[/b][/p][p]
We want to be clear about where we’re at with AI in Pizza Bandit.[/p][p]During our last demo, players told us (loud and clear 😅) that the AI VO wasn’t cutting it. We agreed and went out to work with real VO talent. Replacing it all made the humor and personality shine the way we always wanted. After that, we thought we had fully removed AI and turned the disclaimer off.[/p][p]Turns out we missed one spot: the jukebox in the lobby. It was added late by a dev so players had something fun to mess around with between missions — but it shipped without proper custom support and some AI content slipped in. With launch deadlines looming, our focus stayed on gameplay-critical pieces, and we overlooked it.[/p][p]Here’s where we’re at now:[/p][list][*][p]We’ve already started replacing what we can immediately.[/p][/*][*][p]Some swaps will take longer, but the work is ongoing.[/p][/*][*][p]We turned the AI disclaimer back on — and when we’re 100% confident, we’ll turn it back off.[/p][/*][*][p]We’re already in contact with BGM composers, and their tracks will soon replace the existing jukebox content.[/p][/*][/list][p]And one more thing: our dev philosophy is [b]perfection through endless iteration[/b]. That means along the way, things sometimes get added or changed without us fully tracking every placeholder. We’ve asked our community to call out anything that feels “off” — and we really appreciate you keeping us honest.[/p][p]This is also exactly why we’re going into [b]Early Access[/b]. Your support directly helps us improve Pizza Bandit — making it more fun, more original, and more [i]ours[/i]. Every bit of feedback, every report, every review helps us make the game better together.[/p][p]At the end of the day, we’re not here to replace artists with AI. We’re here to make Pizza Bandit the funniest, most chaotic stress-blowing shooter-chef game possible — with your help.[/p][p]Thanks for sticking with us. ❤️[/p]

notes.title: DevLog #4: Voices, Victories, and Villains
notes.content:
[h2]🚀 [b]Early Access Launches August 25th @ 10AM PT![/b][/h2][p]The countdown is nearly over. In just a few days, you’ll be blasting Time Reapers, baking pizzas under pressure, and building your dream pizzeria—together.[/p][p]But before the doors swing open, we’ve got one last dev update to share.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🛠️ [b]A Quick Look Back[/b][/h3][p]We started this journey in 2023, thinking we’d be able to launch the game by 2024. Like all good pies, it took longer in the oven.[/p][p]With a small team of six—mostly programmers—we began with whatever we could grab from the Unreal Store. It wasn’t until six months in that we finally found art support and began shaping the look and identity of Pizza Bandit. The game has changed [i]a lot[/i] since then, and every change has pushed it closer to the game we always wanted to make.[/p][p]For the past two months, we’ve been in overdrive—polishing systems, recording VO, and locking in our final feature set. The build is currently under review (nerves = high), but here’s what we’ve been working on since our last update:[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🎙️ [b]VO Recording: Locked and Loaded[/b][/h3][p]We heard your feedback on the temp VO in the demo—and we agreed. So we hit the studio with our full cast, and they absolutely delivered.[/p][p]Led by [b]Chris Borders[/b], amazing VO director behind [i]Gears of War[/i], we finally nailed the tone we always wanted: punchy, sarcastic, character-driven.[/p][p]Here’s what to expect:[/p][list][*][p]🎭 [b]Full personality across the board.[/b] Malik’s got bite, and mission handler Finn no longer sounds like a bored robot.[/p][/*][*][p]🎧 [b]Pop culture nods[/b] hidden throughout the dialogue—you’ll know them when you hear them (and hopefully laugh like we did during recording).[/p][/*][*][p]🔊 [b]Boss missions[/b] now feature more unique sound design to bring enemies to life (before you take theirs).[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🏆 [b]Bandit Records: Your Legend Starts Here[/b][/h3][p]Introducing [b]Bandit Records[/b]—our in-game achievement system that tracks your wildest moments and most chaotic plays. Some of them even show up on your Steam profile.[/p][p]A few favorites:[/p][list][*][p][b]Oops[/b] – Accidentally damage your teammate.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Catch This[/b] – Kill a Reaper by throwing food, drinks… or maybe a tuna.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Death from Delivery[/b] – Drop a Pizza Pod on an enemy’s head.[/p][/*][/list][p]Whether you're chasing bragging rights or just causing mayhem, we’ll be watching. 👀[/p][hr][/hr][h3]💀 [b]Reinforced Enemies: Beefed Up and Battle-Ready[/b][/h3][p]Crank up the difficulty, and you’ll start facing [b]Reinforced Time Reapers[/b]—beasts wearing scavenged armor from broken timelines.[/p][p]What makes them scary:[/p][list][*][p]🛡️ [b]Frontal damage won't cut it.[/b] You’ll need to break their armor first—or hit them where it hurts.[/p][/*][*][p]⚔️ [b]Some weapons work better than others[/b], and yes, that includes explosives.[/p][/*][*][p]👀 Visual cues make them easy to spot—if a floating head with a football helmet is charging at you with a fire bomb, prepare accordingly.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44324763/6b0765afb301f3b6bbd88e7a5c6dea9e05ca37a0.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p]They hit harder, last longer, and turn the battlefield into a puzzle. Good luck.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]💬 We’re Just Getting Started[/h2][p]This wraps up our devlogs [i]before[/i] Early Access, but it’s only the beginning of the journey. Your feedback will be critical in shaping what comes next.[/p][p]Join the conversation here:[/p][list][*][p]💬 [url="https://discord.com/invite/27ZZHxyZMV"]Discord[/url][/p][/*][*][p]🌐 [url="https://bsky.app/profile/jofsoft.bsky.social"]Bluesky[/url][/p][/*][*][p]🐦 [url="https://twitter.com/jofsoft"]Twitter/X[/url][/p][/*][*][p]🎵 [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@jofsoft"]TikTok[/url][/p][/*][*][p]📷 [url="https://www.instagram.com/jofsoft"]Instagram[/url][/p][/*][*][p]📺 [url="https://www.youtube.com/@jofsoft3145"]YouTube[/url][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]📅 [b]Once more for the folks in the back...[/b][/h2][h1]🍕 [b]Early Access begins August 25th @ 10AM PT on Steam![/b][/h1][p]Grab your crew. Lock in your loadouts. Fire up the oven.
[b]Pizza Bandit is almost open for business.[/b][/p][p]— Team JofSoft[/p]

notes.title: Dev Log #3: Time Reapers, Visual Upgrades & Dev Process
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hey Bandits,[/b][/h1]
With our [b]Early Access release date now official[/b] (!!!), we wanted to take a moment to reflect on how far we’ve come — especially when it comes to one of the most important parts of the game’s identity:
[b]The Time Reapers.[/b]

Let’s talk about what they are, how they’ve evolved, and the journey we’ve taken to get them looking and feeling just right.

[h2]🕳️ [b]What Are Time Reapers?[/b][/h2]In the world of [i]Pizza Bandit[/i], [b]Time Reapers are the keepers of the space-time continuum[/b]. Every time Malik jumps into a mission through time travel, he’s breaking natural laws — and the longer he stays, the more Time Reapers start to manifest.

Originally imagined as higher alien entities protecting the universe from irresponsible time-travelers, Time Reapers evolved as our lore deepened. We began introducing the idea of [b]zombified humans who were caught in fractured timelines[/b] — distorted humanoids partially entangled with metal.

Now, they serve as both gameplay threats and reminding you what you'll become if you get stuck in any of you rmissions.

[h2]🧰 [b]How We Build: From Prototype to Personality[/b][/h2]As an indie team working with limited resources, our development process has always been about [b]building the gameplay first[/b], then layering on visuals as we grow. And we are one of those studio with less luck on the art talents. Somehow in 2024, we were able to pull in a close friend in who's been nothing but amazing. 

In the early stages, we used [b]placeholder and store-bought assets[/b] to test mechanics and experiment quickly. It helped us focus on pacing, combat feel, and mission design while we defined the tone of the world. If you were at PAX West in 2023, you would've seen this build that we put together in four month. 

Once those systems were in place, we gradually began replacing temporary elements with [b]original art and models created in-house[/b]. One of the biggest areas of transformation?
→ [b]The Time Reapers and our character model.[/b]

While not every single placeholder will be gone by Early Access, we’re committed to replacing them one by one. The work is ongoing, but we’re proud of how far we’ve already come — and we’re excited to show you what’s next.

[h2]💀 [b]Reimagining the Time Reapers[/b]
[/h2]Here are some of the Time Reapers we’ve recently upgraded — and the thinking behind their designs:

[h3][b]Frankie (Type A & B)[/b]
[/h3]Fast. Fragile. Freaky. Frankies are the first Time Reapers you meet — and they come in two forms:
• [b]Type A[/b] – Upright, frantic runners
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44324763/7390f425b239940ecdff43de986f13e61c99d497.png"][/img]
• [b]Type B[/b] – Crawlers that make it difficult to aim especially when they are dashing towards you. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44324763/b1fab9b659a6e8880e81e73b2f460ed43fa1bb9d.png"][/img]They used to be generic grunts. Now they look like malformed reanimates caught mid-snap from one timeline to another. 
[h3][b]Ignifera[/b]
[/h3]Originally a basic enemy with fire range attack, we completely redesigned her to embody decay, molten energy, and otherworldly elegance. Her glowing veins and gas pipe connenting to each hand create a unique silhouette.[b] [/b][b]  [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44324763/bb18d12b432cc0dcc215132f82a716afc1a255d9.png"][/img][h3][b]Stipula[/b][/h3]The original Stipula was little more than a turret disguised as a meat lump. Now, it’s a grotesque stationary showcasing exaggerated entanglement between meat, human form and metal.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44324763/e22e04b85708f278e5cb04ddea82b3cf167ac6b1.png"][/img]
[h3][b]Hemicraft[/b]
[/h3]You haven’t seen this one in action yet — but you will. Hemicraft is our first flying Reaper, and we wanted it to be both uncanny and irritating. Its new model now looks like something cobbled together in a lab and left to rot mid-air. My personal favorite in terms of visual, but I just know I'll hate this one the most when playing the game.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44324763/8b5d1fc25c33c847683ee05b70be6f0d050f23e0.png"][/img]
[h2]🧢 [b]Character Model: Malik’s Evolution[/b][/h2]
We’ve also given our protagonist the glow-up he deserves. Early builds of Malik were built from prototyping kits — but now he’s got personality, swagger, and gear that fits the tone of the world. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44324763/42f405998034645c93eb28a13e2bb57a47fe2ee7.png"][/img] We also added layers of customization to help players stand out in multiplayer, while still keeping Malik central to the story. 

[h2]🔭 [b]What’s Next[/b][/h2]
As we roll into Early Access and toward 1.0 release, we will:
• Continued visual upgrades
• More original monster designs
• A steady replacement of any remaining placeholders

Thanks for sticking with us on this journey. We’ve come a long way from our first prototype, and it’s only getting better from here.

Want to see more or share your thoughts on Time Reapers? [url=https://discord.gg/27ZZHxyZMV]Join us on Discord[/url] — we’d love to hear what monsters you want to fight next 👹

[b]– JofSoft Team[/b]

notes.title: Pizza Bandit Dev Log #2
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hey Bandits, Let’s Talk About Food & Firepower![/b][/h1]

We’ve been hard at work refining what makes [i]Pizza Bandit[/i] unique — chaotic cooking missions, satisfying combat, and a lot of personality. After showcasing our sushi mission at [b]PAX West[/b], [b]G-STAR[/b], and [b]Taiwan Game Show[/b], it became clear: [b]Cooking is core to the fun.[/b] So we’re leaning in all the way.

If you want to chat with us or share feedback, hang out in our [url=https://discord.gg/27ZZHxyZMV]Discord[/url]!

[h2]🍣 [b]Cooking Missions & Restaurant Upgrades[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Sushi Mission — Crowd Favorite[/b][/h3]
We’ve experimented with different mission types, and the [b]cooking-centric ones hit differently[/b]. They bring out the humor, chaos, and team coordination better than anything else. Here's a quick look at our sushi mission.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44324763/1cb067aefb58b4dd2bf2e493096776fc3aaf4fa0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44324763/44eaa7266ada30d604c93eff7fcc4e70b05d2ff2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44324763/9520c161a936a2808c783558d1c97e6cb744ab85.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44324763/62fa388bdbbf219be229d367010611c47be9af35.png[/img]

[h2][b]Restaurant Customization — More Than Just a Lobby[/b][/h2]
We always wanted the [i]Pizza Bandit[/i] restaurant to feel alive. We tested a bunch of ideas, but the one that stuck? [b]Decorating, customizing, and upgrading your pizzeria — and making pizzas that’ll help your team.[/b]

Now, it feels like a natural part of the story:
• Customize and upgrade your shop layout 🍽️
• Unlock kitchen gear and decor
• Your restaurant level will give you certain benefits in the mission

[previewyoutube=eDsQxH5k5Uk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]Making Pizza in your Lobby[/b][/h2]
We’ve completely reworked how pizza-making functions outside of missions:
[list]
[*] [b]Loot ingredients (toppings)[/b] from missions — you'll need them to craft pizzas
[*] [b]Make your custom pizza[/b] in the lobby kitchen
[*] [b]Pull the pizza from the oven[/b] and place it on the table to share with your friends
[*] [b]Toppings dictate the type of buff[/b] you’ll receive
[*] [b]Buffs apply right from the lobby[/b] and remain active until you get knocked down during a mission
[/list]
And here’s the twist — [b]during missions, when you successfully perform cooking actions[/b], you’ll earn [b]Cooking Points[/b]. Rack up enough points and you’ll [b]unlock new pizza recipes[/b] that come with [b]stronger and more specialized buffs[/b].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44324763/cb1c1efe13999c1a6a4b9fc265fb9c45810cdb02.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44324763/5eb526c6675d3f58ff5d461a0297552a2204f079.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44324763/3b53a6c5d961a986cbff305e31627362c0aae838.png[/img]

[h2]🔫 [b]Weapon Mods & Loadout Expansion[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Weapon Modification System Overhaul[/b][/h3]
We’ve moved beyond basic stat boosts. Every weapon in Pizza Bandit now comes with [b]modification categories[/b], and within each, you’ll choose from [b]2–3 unique upgrades[/b] to tailor your build. This lets you make meaningful decisions and allows your gear to match your playstyle—whether focused on firepower, utility, or survival.

[previewyoutube=4Im3nsdn0r0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]Weapon Ascension (WIP)[/b][/h3]
We’re exploring a new system called [b]Weapon Ascension[/b]. The idea is to give your favorite gear a second life, transforming a fully upgraded weapon into something even more powerful, possibly with unique effects or behavior. It’s still in development, but we’ll share more once the system is ready for feedback. 👀
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44324763/b26aa775877aa6591f256ebeccd0f5e15d827860.png[/img]

That’s it for now — but we’re not done yet. Dev Log #3 will dive into cosmetics, monsters (old and new), and a few chaotic missions you haven’t seen before.

Until then, [url=https://discord.gg/27ZZHxyZMV]come say hi on Discord[/url] and let us know what toppings you’re loading up 🍍🔥

[b]– JofSoft Team[/b]

notes.title: Pizza Bandit Dev Log #1
notes.content:
[h3][b]👋 Hey Bandits![/b][/h3]

It’s been a minute — but we’re back! Starting now, we’ll be posting [b]more frequent dev logs[/b] (for real this time) to share our progress, talk through features we’re working on, and show off what’s coming next.
We want [i]Pizza Bandit[/i] to be something we build [b]with[/b] our community, not just for it — so if you’ve got ideas, feedback, or just want to hang with us during development, come join our [url=https://discord.gg/27ZZHxyZMV]Discord[/url]. We’re always listening.
[h2][b]⚙️ Quality of Life Updates[/b][/h2]
We’ve made a bunch of small but mighty improvements based directly on your feedback. Here’s what’s new:
[h3][b]🥊 Quick Melee (with Smart Swap)[/b][/h3]
You asked for a fast melee option while holding a gun — something quick and crunchy.
[list]
[*] We added a [b]quick melee button (default: V)[/b]. Personally, I like binding it to the scroll wheel press.
[*] Then came the issue: “How do I get back to my gun quickly?”
[*] The answer: [b]just right-click[/b], and boom — you’re right back to your the weapon you were holding.
[/list][previewyoutube=vSPD_f9hh8o;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3][b]📦 Seamless Object & Combat Switching[/b][/h3]
You carry a lot in this game — pizzas, relics, and… fish? Switching back to combat was kind of clunky before.
Now:
[list]
[*] [b]Right-click while holding an object[/b] to instantly drop it and go back to your last gun you were holding. (video stills shows it going back to primary weapon, but in the final version it'll be previous gun you were holding before picking up an object)
[*] Same logic as melee. Super fast, super clean.
[/list]
[previewyoutube=NqK8DpB-Ur0;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3][b]🎮 Controller & Steam Deck Support[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Controller support is [b]getting better every week[/b], though not perfect just yet.
[*] [b]PS controller support[/b] is on the way before Early Access.
[*] [b]Steam Deck?[/b] Yep — it runs! You’ll want to tweak settings for smooth performance, but it’s 100% playable.
[/list]
[h2][b]💡Upgrade to Unreal Engine 5 [/b][/h2]
We’ve made the leap to [b]Unreal Engine 5[/b]!
That means:
[list]
[*] Better lighting ☀️
[*] Improved environmental effects 🌫️
[*] Overall visual polish ✨
[/list]
We’re still working on optimization and aim to get UE5 running [i]as smoothly as UE4 did[/i], if not better. Although this isn't the final version, here is an example of improvement you can expect.
[h3][b]UE4 Screenshots in different quality settings[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44324763/9476d947f074405886aa5db8dc3589b573a4fd15.png[/img]
[h3][b]UE5 Screenshots in different quality settings[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44324763/3f3c0e7a5722e966c9f5c9965b5fe43feabe85af.png[/img]
And here is a little sneak peek.
[previewyoutube=CvcQHz-BYsk;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3][b]🚀 That’s It For Now![/b][/h3]
In the future dev logs, we’ll dig into the [b]cooking missions[/b], [b]restaurant customization[/b], and [b]weapon mods[/b]—plus some juicy new mission content and a look at the monster updates you haven’t seen yet. 👀
Thanks for riding with us. Got feedback, feature requests, or weird pizza topping ideas? [b]Drop a comment below[/b] or come hang out in our [url=https://discord.gg/27ZZHxyZMV]Discord[/url]!

[b]🍕 Stay crispy,
– JofSoft Team[/b]

[h2]What’s Next?[/h2]
We will take all the feedback and data collected during this alpha phase and get back to work on refining gameplay, squashing bugs, and adding more content. We’re committed to making Pizza Bandit the best game it can be, and we can't do it without your help.

Stay tuned for more updates, and we hope you're as excited as we are about what’s coming next. Thank you again for your support and participation. Let's make Pizza Bandit a game we all can be proud of!

Thanks,
[b]Pizza Bandit Team[/b]

notes.title: The Pizza Bandit Closed Alpha Playtest is Now Live!
notes.content:
[h2][h1]Hello, Pizza Bandit enthusiasts![/h1][/h2]

We are thrilled to announce that the Closed Alpha Playtest for Pizza Bandit has officially begun! This is your exclusive opportunity to dive into the early stages of our game and help us fine-tune the mechanics, balance, and fun factors.

[h3]If You Have Your Alpha Key:[/h3]

[olist]
[*] Check your email for your Alpha Test Key if you haven’t received it yet.
[*] Activate the product using the Key.
[*] Download and install the game.
[*] Start playing and exploring the world of Pizza Bandit!
[/olist]

[h3]Missed Signing Up?[/h3]
Don’t worry! If you missed the initial sign-up period, you can still participate. Simply visit our Steam store page and click on "Request Access" to join the ongoing Alpha Test. We’re looking forward to welcoming more of you into the fold!

[h3]We Want Your Feedback:[/h3]
Your feedback is crucial to us. Please utilize the dedicated discussion board here on Steam or our #alpha-feedback channel on Discord to let us know your thoughts. Every piece of feedback will be considered as we continue to improve and expand the game. Join our Discord here: https://discord.gg/27ZZHxyZMV

[h3]Support:[/h3]
If you encounter any issues or have questions, please contact us directly at contact@jofsoft.co.kr or reach out in our #alpha-feedback channel on Discord.

Thank you for being a part of this journey with us. We can’t wait to see you in the game and hear what you think. Let’s make Pizza Bandit the best it can be, together!

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Pizza Bandit Demo Update v0.5.176
notes.content:
[h3]Thank you for playing the "Pizza Bandit" demo and providing feedback. Over the past week, with almost daily updates, we'd like to share the modifications and improvements made.[/h3]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Resolved issues with battles not functioning correctly due to terrain glitches.
[*] Fixed an error popping up when the game was initiated with a Steam VR device connected.
[*] Rectified abnormal path guidance after mission clearance in the restaurant.
[*] Addressed an issue where pressing ESC in the result window rendered the player's character invisible.
[*] Amended situations where players were unable to collect ammunition dropped by monsters in some cases.
[/list]

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Enhanced clarity of mission instructions at the start of the Ginko Town mission.
[*] Increased the interaction scope for the refrigerator in the Restaurant mission.
[*] Corrected the overly dim view of the underground while spectating other players post-death. 
[/list]

[h3]Thank you for your significant interest and affection for "Pizza Bandit". Please add it to your wishlist.[/h3]
Pizza Bandit Devs

notes.content:
🍕 Pizza Bandit Developer Live Stream: Behind the Slices! 🎮
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44324763/3c2616c660db7a284f1f11e15e141a95d57361ed.gif[/img]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2475010/Pizza_Bandit/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44324763/8b2efca6e3a309900b8d876cfa15dbbf19e88b51.gif[/img][/url]
Join us for a special live stream as we dive deep into the world of "Pizza Bandit"! As a 3rd Person Monster Hell Shooter, this game offers a unique mix of frantic combat and humor. In this session, our dedicated team at Jofsoft will give you an insider's look into:

🎮 Game Mechanics: How we integrated Souls-like combat sequences with precision attacks and timely dodges, all at 4x speed!
😂 Parody Missions: A sneak peek into some of our funniest and most challenging parody missions inspired by iconic games.
🤝 Co-op Dynamics: Experience firsthand how we've designed missions that challenge and entertain a four-player team.
🛠️ Development Journey: From the lessons learned from "Rift Sweepers" to the latest tweaks based on player feedback.
💬 Q&A Session: Got questions? We're here to answer! Engage directly with our devs and share your thoughts and suggestions.
So, if you're hungry for gaming insights (or just pizza talk), tune in and share a slice of development fun with us!
